newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar slips as interest rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar slips as interest rates fall.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed off at 467.50/468.75 per dollar as investors switched into dollars ahead of today's four percentage point fall in interest rates, traders said.
The bolivar closed on Tuesday at 465.00/466.00 per dollar.
Banks bought dollars on the interbank market in the morning "to cover themselves against the expected drop in interest rates," said one trader.
Yields on benchmark Central Bank six month TEMs fell 468 basis points to 24.18 percent in today's 40 billion bolivar ($85 million) auction.
Traders said the demand for dollars "stemmed solely from the interbank market and not from corporate demand."
In keeping with recent sessions, they added the Central Bank did not participate in the market and only monitored trade from the sidelines.
